wins: A simple green deck for learning: ramp with Llanowar Elves, play a bigger creature each turn, and win every fight with pump spells and Rabid Bite.
plan: Llanowar Elves: an extra mana every turn after.
Elvish Visionary (draws), Grizzly Bears, Centaur Courser, Giant Spider. Attack when your creatures are bigger.
Colossal Dreadmaw (6/6 trample). Use Giant Growth and Titanic Growth to win combats, Rabid Bite to remove blockers.
keys: Turn-1 ramp: lets you cast a 3-drop on turn 2.
Your creature deals damage to theirs, one-sided: green’s removal.
Flash and deathtouch: a surprise blocker that kills anything.
tips: Pump spells are instants: use them after blockers are declared.
Giant Spider has reach and blocks flying creatures.
Rabid Bite works best after a pump spell makes your creature bigger.
mulligan: Keep 2–4 Forests with Llanowar Elves or two creatures.
